capabilities: poll watched folders every 3 seconds for external file changes
compare disk contents with Obsidian's internal index to find missing files
inject TFile objects and fire vault create events so the explorer updates
customize watched folders and interval by editing constants in main.js
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install manually or via BRAT. No settings UI — configuration requires editing constants in main.js.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in file watcher sometimes fails to detect files created by external sync tools
motivation: The author kept closing notes on a phone that synced via Syncthing but never appeared in Obsidian's sidebar until a manual reload.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file watcher often misses files created by external sync tools, especially on Windows, so new files only appear after a manual vault reload.

requires.name: an external sync tool such as Syncthing, Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or rsync

summary: File explorer refresher that polls vault folders and injects files created by external sync tools into Obsidian's index without a reload.
